name: Override: carry a stack to a Neutral Goal
description: Drives the bite onto the yellow stack at (23.5, -23.5), closes the claw on the Cup's rim and sets the stack on the Pin in the neutral left Goal. The lift rises during the turn and goes down 0.3 s after the robot starts backing away. The left Toggle is still yellow, so the stack scores for neither alliance.

steps.note: the bite onto the stack until the Cup meets the plate
close on the Cup's top rim
the bite onto the Goal: the stack is over its Pin
set the Cup's rim on the Goal's Pin
back away, then lower the lift
